description:
Validate one or more JSON documents against a project's stored JSON Schema.

The schema is regenerated from the project using the supplied configTypeId (the export profile id) and rootNodeId, then reused for every document - so validating a batch costs barely more than validating one. Pass up to 100 documents per call and chunk anything larger.

Response:
- isValid: true only when EVERY document passed.
- total, validCount: counts over the whole batch.
- invalid: one entry per failing document, as {index, errors}. Only failures are listed - any index not present passed. index is the 0-based position in the jsonStrings array you sent.
- A document that is not parseable JSON fails in its own slot; it does not abort the rest of the batch.

Set explain=true to add a plain-English "- Explanation:" line to every error, describing what is wrong, where, and how to fix it. The raw structured lines are unchanged either way - use it when a person will read the result, leave it off for machine parsing.

configTypeId.description: Profile id used to map mixins/relations to schema keywords

explain.description: Add a plain-English explanation to each error alongside the raw structured fields. Use when a person will read the output.

jsonStrings.description: The JSON documents to validate, each serialized as a string. Results reference documents by their 0-based position in this array.

rootNodeId.description: Node id used as the root when generating the JSON Schema

spaceId.description: Optional space id to scope the schema

name: validate_json
title: Validate JSON
